evidence: A satisfying settlement assigns communications to Bay East, battery conditioning to Bay West at 0900-1100, calibration to the Equipment Room at 1300-1500, hazardous-material packaging to Cage 2 with a 1600 seal, includes an access_board_update commitment, and cites PF1 after PF1 is revealed. A plausible uninformed settlement could use Bay West for communications, Bay East for batteries, Cage 3 for packaging, and omit the exact windows, thereby failing C1-C3 and C6-C7.
